\begin{tablenotes}[flushleft]
\small
\item \textit{Notes:} Sample is ACS individuals aged 25+ in the analytical universe (2016-2024, dropping AK / HI and negative family income). The Multnomah column restricts to individuals whose prior-year county of residence was Multnomah; the Non-Multnomah column is everyone else in the sample. Person- and household-level survey weights are applied throughout. Total income sums household-level family income over household-head records. Migration rates are based on IPUMS prior-year residence: a county move is any inter- or intra-state move; a state move is a different state of residence in the prior year. Panel C reports weighted percentages of individuals within each column.
\item Source: ACS microdata via IPUMS (2016-2024).
\end{tablenotes}
